gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 164.—It is hereby notified that the following thoroughfare will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Private road within I.L. 1298 commencing at its junction with Catchick Street at the mid-point of the Northern boundary of the said lot and running in a Southerly direction for 80 feet and then in an Easterly direction for 40 feet ending in a cul-de-sac as shown coloured red on Plan No. R.H. 666. English Name: KIN MAN STREET. Chinese Name: 健文街.
